verdict.rationale: MoonPay's documented API/SDK surface is entirely about consumer-initiated on-ramp (buy) and off-ramp (sell) widget flows with quotes, session tokens, KYC, and webhooks (e.g. moonpay-docs-14, -15, -23, -36) — there is no documented endpoint for a developer/business to programmatically push a stablecoin payout to an arbitrary wallet address or stored recipient with settlement status tracking, which is a distinct disbursement/payout capability. No evidence pack item describes such a send-to-wallet payout API, only end-customer sell-to-cash flows.
